name: Loyd's Electric Supply, Inc.
old_description: Proudly serving the Ozarks since 1961, Loyd's Electric Supply is Southwest Missouri and Northwest Arkansas's leading electrical wholesale supplier.  We feature a large selection of in-stock products including wire, gear and circuit breakers, light bulbs, lighting, wiring devices, conduit, tools, and much more. Our experienced sales force is here to help you with your job or project, and our fleet of trucks are standing by to deliver your material to you when you need it.
about:
Since its founding in 1961, Loyd's Electric Supply, Inc. has been headquartered in Springfield, Missouri, serving the Ozarks region across Southwest Missouri and Northwest Arkansas. The company operates as an electrical wholesale distributor, supplying contractors and industrial buyers with a broad range of electrical materials.

The distributor stocks wire, gear and circuit breakers, light bulbs, lighting fixtures, wiring devices, conduit, and tools, maintaining inventory for immediate pickup or delivery. A company-owned fleet of trucks transports orders to job sites throughout the service territory, while an experienced sales force assists with product selection and project coordination.

Customers span electrical contracting firms, commercial and residential builders, industrial maintenance teams, and municipal facilities in the Ozarks. The product offering supports new construction, renovation, and ongoing maintenance and repair operations across those sectors.

The company highlights its six-decade regional presence, extensive in-stock inventory, and dedicated delivery fleet as factors that distinguish it from broader-line distributors. By combining local stock depth with rapid delivery, Loyd's Electric Supply aims to minimize downtime for contractors on time-sensitive projects.
